chapter_title: How I Taught My Grandmother to Read & Bharat Our Land
summary: This unit pairs Sudha Murty's biographical memoir 'How I Taught My Grandmother to Read' with Subramania Bharati's nationalist poem 'Bharat Our Land'. The prose recounts the determination of Krishtakka, a 62-year-old illiterate village woman, who learns the Kannada alphabet from her 12-year-old granddaughter after experiencing intense helplessness when she cannot read her favorite serialized novel 'Kashi Yatre'. The poem celebrates India's majestic physical geography, spiritual heritage, intellectual traditions, and egalitarian societal ideals.
